results.title: Algeria’s army chief says Niger deployment guards shared energy sites | Military Africa
results.snippet:
## Kafra, the pipeline and Zinder

Algeria’s interests in Niger centre on energy. State-owned Sonatrach is exploring the Kafra oil block in northern Niger with Niger’s Sonidep, and the two countries are partners in the Trans-Saharan Gas Pipeline, which would carry Nigerian gas through Niger to Algeria for export to Europe.
